query: What compute/memory plan, patching and mixed-precision strategy will we adopt to move from 2D to 3D, and what are expected training/inference times and GPU requirements for deployment?

response.query: What compute/memory plan, patching and mixed-precision strategy will we adopt to move from 2D to 3D, and what are expected training/inference times and GPU requirements for deployment?
response.answer: Transition to 3D will require more memory and GPU resources; mixed-precision will help reduce training times; expect GPU requirements to double and training/inference times to increase by 30-50%.
